title: Antioxidant activities of novel peptides from Limosilactobacillus reuteri fermented brown rice: A combined in vitro and in silico study.
authors: Tyagi, Akanksha; Chelliah, Ramachandran; Banan-Mwine Daliri, Eric; Sultan, Ghazala; Madar, Inamul Hasan; Kim, Namehyeon; Shabbir, Umair; Oh, Deog-Hwan
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦发酵糙米来源抗氧化肽的体外活性与Keap1结合模拟，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且方法为分子对接但对象非核酸，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxidative stress is known to cause cell apoptosis, tissue damage, and pathological changes in the body, but antioxidant peptides are renowned radical scavengers. This study investigated the antioxidative and protective effect of six novel peptides obtained after microbial fermentation of brown rice. The selected peptides (MW </= 8 KDa), namely AVPYPQ (P1), ILTAV (P2), LGDVIGVP (P3), NPIFDYVLLP (P4), VAPFPEV (P5), and VLPVPK (P6) exhibited strong antioxidant potential against in vitro radicals with IC(50) values for DPPH (5.12 +/- 0.9-12.54 +/- 0.6 microg/ml), ABTS (5.97 +/- 0.2-14.20 +/- 1.5 microg/ml), FRAP (4.98 +/- 2.2-12.19 +/- 0.8 microg/ml) and PSC (9.71 +/- 0.5-17.84 +/- 1.3 microg/ml),respectively. Additionally, these peptides reduced ROS concentrations in Caco-2 cells treated with hydrogen peroxide. In silico studies indicated all six peptides had a higher binding score for the Keap1-Kelch domain than TX6, a potential Keap1 reference ligand. These findings suggest peptides derived from fermented brown rice might be functional components in foods.
abstract_zh: 已知氧化应激会引起细胞凋亡、组织损伤及体内病理变化，而抗氧化肽是著名的自由基清除剂。本研究探讨了褐米经微生物发酵后获得的六种新型肽的抗氧化及保护作用。所选肽段（分子量 ≤ 8 KDa），即 AVPYPQ (P1)、ILTAV (P2)、LGDVIGVP (P3)、NPIFDYVLLP (P4)、VAPFPEV (P5) 和 VLPVPK (P6)，在体外自由基清除实验中表现出强抗氧化潜力，其对 DPPH、ABTS、FRAP 和 PSC 的 IC(50) 值分别为 5.12 ± 0.9–12.54 ± 0.6 μg/ml、5.97 ± 0.2–14.20 ± 1.5 μg/ml、4.98 ± 2.2–12.19 ± 0.8 μg/ml 和 9.71 ± 0.5–17.84 ± 1.3 μg/ml。此外，这些肽能降低经过氧化氢处理的 Caco-2 细胞中的 ROS 浓度。计算机模拟研究表明，所有六种肽对 Keap1-Kelch 结构域的结合评分均高于 TX6（一种潜在的 Keap1 参考配体）。这些发现表明，源自发酵褐米的肽可能作为食品中的功能性成分。
